title: mocon Payload
description: core.md section 5.4. Atomic: always emitted whole within one line. No required fields. A Payload with no value MUST set truncated or redacted.

value.description: Any JSON value. Binary values are base64-encoded strings; a reference the host holds instead of content (a URL, a file id) is carried as that reference. Core carries no marker distinguishing the three cases and a consumer MUST NOT infer which one a value is (core.md 5.4); a host MAY note its own encoding under the record's top-level ext, which core consumers ignore. Opaque: a consumer MUST NOT interpret it beyond displaying it.

truncated.description: When true, value is a string holding a prefix of the host's serialization of the original. bytes and hash, when present, describe the original, not the prefix.

redacted.description: The host removed or replaced content by policy. {"redacted": true} with no value is legal.

bytes.description: Size in bytes of the host's serialization of the original.

hash.description: sha256 over the host's serialization of the original. Comparable only within one host.
